newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson edges up as merger rumours wane.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson edges up as merger rumours wane.

text.p: Swedish telecoms giant LM Ericsson AB edged higher in early trade on Thursday while Finnish rival Nokia Oy strengthened but rumours about a merger of the two companies started to wane.
At 0945 GMT Ericsson was one crown higher at 207 crowns. On Wednesday Ericsson rose 9.5 crowns on rumours of a merger with Nokia.
"Even though the rumour is starting to die out we are still seeing buying interest in Ericsson," one broker told Reuters.
"But the merger is not seen as likely. The two companies are too alike and would not be a perfect match, cannibalising each others market share."
By 0945 GMT Nokia was 7.5 higher at 262.50 markka.
"People are continuing to buy Nokia because people see it as so much lower valued than Ericsson," the broker said.
